decisions.decision: Keep T-409 as the single small input task for this redeploy; nothing else waits on it except the T-157 mirror publish. At the start of every run, check whether Claude in Chrome is connected on profile 'Browser 1' (adi@growthclub.org). If it is, do the redeploy yourself: paste workshop-plan/ops/apps-script/Code.gs, Manage deployments > edit > New version > Deploy, typing no password. Once the health GET of the exec URL lists tier_qualifier (whether you or Adi redeployed), post one tier_qualifier probe row and confirm it lands in the Work Tracker. Then publish the /workshop/join and /masterclass/success/join qualifier to the tantra-workshop-live mirror, rerun app/scripts/probe-tier-qualifier.mjs, and close T-409 and the T-157 hold with evidence. Do not reroute qualifier answers through another form key.
